# an on-screen ai that points, so you learn by doing

The 'how-do-I' layer for your screen. Hold a key and ask out loud Photoshop, Excel, the browser, a chess board, anything you can see - and HeyBraza points, draws exactly where to click and walks you through the step. Learn it in minutes, not a 20-hour course.

## the apps people ask for most.

### Blender

Free 3D software for modeling, animation and renders. HeyBraza points at the right tool the second you ask, so you get through blender's menus and actually finish the render.

### Figma

Where teams design apps and websites together, in the browser. HeyBraza points right at auto-layout, a component or whatever you're hunting for, live in your own file.

### CapCut

The fast, free editor for reels, tiktoks and shorts. HeyBraza shows you the cut, caption or effect you're after - your reel, ready to post.

### Power BI

Microsoft's tool for turning spreadsheets into live dashboards. HeyBraza points at the exact field and walks you through the dax for your measure or chart.

### Claude Code

An AI coding teammate that edits your project from the terminal. HeyBraza points at the next step to run in the terminal - you ship the change, and actually get it.

### Premiere Pro

The pro video editor behind most youtube videos, films and ads. HeyBraza points at the exact trim, caption or export button the moment you ask, live on your own timeline.

### Photoshop

The industry standard for editing photos and making graphics. HeyBraza points at the exact panel for the mask or retouch you need - you do the work, so the skill sticks.

### Unity

The game engine behind a huge share of mobile and indie games. HeyBraza points at the setting to fix when your scene won't play - you learn the engine by shipping.

### DaVinci Resolve

The film-grade editor famous for its color grading. HeyBraza points at the right node for a grade or a cut, live on your own footage.

### AutoCAD

The classic app for drafting floor plans and technical drawings. HeyBraza points at the command you need - you draft the plan yourself, dimensioned right.
